what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Cuba in Brazil: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 65949 Cuban asylum seekers in Brazil, 22.9% of all asylum seekers from Cuba.
Refugees from Cuba, a separate group, live mostly in Mexico and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Cuba, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 7 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Brazil.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Brazil only.
